content.text:
Plan submitted — all 18 rules searched and routed.

**Summary of what the workers will inherit:**

- **Live clauses to analyse:** LOL-CAP (§9.7 + §6.2), INDEMN (§6.3, Servicer/Marketing Agent indemnities running to us), T4C (§8.3, §7.1 No Resignation, §7.2 Servicer Termination Events), GOVLAW (§§10.5–10.7 New York/SDNY plus the Article XI dispute-resolution regime), ASSIGN (§10.2 plus §5.3 and §7.6 merger-succession), IP (§9.4 and the Custodian file provisions), AUDIT (§3.6, running in our favour), LD (Make-Whole mechanics only), WARRANTY (§§2.5, 5.1, 6.1 and the servicing standard), TRANSITION (§7.5), LICENSE (no grant; §7.5 carve-out is the operative text).
- **Likely absent / not applicable:** NONCOMPETE, EXCLUSIVITY, MFN, NOSOLICIT, RENEWAL, INSURANCE, MINCOMMIT.

Two flags worth the reviewing team's attention: Article X paragraph ids for §10.2 were not returned by snippet search, so the ASSIGN worker must paginate `sec-x` directly; and §7.5 (p0346) — the Servicer's express refusal to license processes, models or servicing software, and the confidentiality/data-protection carve-out on what it must hand over — sits at the intersection of IP, LICENSE and TRANSITION, so those three workers should coordinate to avoid flagging the same commercial term three times.
